fato_historico: 1990: West and East Germany announce that they will reunite on October 3.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos hums with the spirit of unity today, Capricorn. Much like fragmented pieces finding their way back into a harmonious whole, you may feel inspired to bridge gaps in your own life. It is a wonderful time to reconcile ambitious plans with emotional needs, creating a firm, unified foundation for your future achievements and long-term dreams.
frase_do_dia: Coming together is a beginning, keeping together is progress, working together is success.
significado_numero: Represents the stability of building a secure and balanced structure.
conselho: Consider mending a professional rift to strengthen your position and peace of mind.
